text: Cycling is a popular sport and transportation method that involves riding a bicycle at a controlled speed for recreation, transport, and exercise. One of the most essential components of cycling is the tires, which provide the necessary cushioning and traction on various surfaces. Properly selected tires are vital for maintaining comfortable and safe rides. Cyclists choose from a variety of tire designs to suit different terrains, such as urban streets, rolling hills, and mountain trails, ensuring they have the best performance. The right combination of tire pressure and tread pattern can enhance a cyclist's efficiency and control. Alongside tires, proper bicycle brakes are crucial for stopping and controlling speed, preventing accidents, and ensuring a secure and enjoyable ride. Modern brakes come in various styles and materials, catering to different rider preferences and specific riding conditions.
